name: Ilkrud Magthrull's Tome
summary: At Fire Scar Shrine, Ilkrud Magthrull's Tome draws Delgren the Purifier's attention. Its pages connect the warlock to the cultists at the Tower of Althalaxx.

sections.title: A Grimoire of Corruption
sections.body: Ilkrud Magthrull holds the Fire Scar Shrine in southwestern Ashenvale, where demonic influence has poisoned the site. The formidable orc warlock is surrounded by summoned minions. His personal tome records foul rituals and shadowy communications. The Argent Dawn paladin Delgren the Purifier has long known of Magthrull's presence, but the ties between the warlock and the dark cultists gathering at the Tower of Althalaxx make the book urgent to recover.

sections.title: Unraveling the Cult
sections.body: After Magthrull is slain, his tome is brought to Delgren at Maestra's Post. Delgren works to decipher the warlock's writings and understand the network coordinating demonic activity across the borders of Darkshore and Ashenvale. The text offers vital intelligence on the shadowy conspirators directing the corruption spreading through northern Kalimdor.

faq.answer: Ilkrud Magthrull owns the tome. He is a powerful orc warlock established among the demonic ruins of Fire Scar Shrine in southwestern Ashenvale.
The tome is recovered from Ilkrud Magthrull at Fire Scar Shrine, south of the Shrine of Aessina in Ashenvale.

faq.q: Why does Delgren the Purifier want the book?
faq.answer: Delgren seeks to study Magthrull's writings and uncover the ties between local demon-worshipers and the cultists inhabiting the Tower of Althalaxx.

faq.q: What happens after the tome is recovered?
aliases: what does delgren do with the book
faq.answer: Delgren examines the text at Maestra's Post, seeking to decipher Magthrull's demonic communications and determine how to dismantle the cult's network.

angles.text: As a paladin, you help Brother Delgren, a fellow warrior of the Holy Light who stands against shadow and corruption in Ashenvale's wilderness.
As a warlock, you can study Magthrull's grimoire, a record of dark bindings and the subjugation of voidwalkers and succubi at the tainted Fire Scar Shrine.
